newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: BPI says SEC approves CityTrust merger.
newsitem.headline: BPI says SEC approves CityTrust merger.

text.p: The Bank of the Philippine Islands (BPI) said on Friday the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) had approved its merger plan with CityTrust Banking Corp.
"We were advised that our application for merger was approved," BPI corporate secretary Carlos Aquino told Reuters.
Aquino said the official documents were expected to be released within a week's time.
"The effective date of the merger will be the date the SEC releases the papers. The name of CityTrust will then cease to exist," Aquino said.
However, he said the operations of the bank will continue. A structural and operational merger was expected to begin by the end of the month.
The merger of the two banks will increase BPI's branch network to 409 fromt he present 357.
BPI earlier projected an annual 20 percent increase in its net income for the next five years due to the merger.
